[ASSISTANT_SAID] The assistant praised the user for maintaining a daily cleaning routine and noted its impact on mental clarity and well-being.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] The assistant provided a list of tips to maximize storage space and keep bathroom cabinets tidy, including:  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] 1. Purge and declutter: Remove everything from cabinets and sort items into three piles: keep, donate/sell, and discard.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] 2. Categorize and group: Sort items into groups like skincare, haircare, oral care, medications, and miscellaneous.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] 3. Assign a home: Designate a specific spot for each group or category.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] 4. Use adjustable shelves and baskets: Create separate compartments within cabinets.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] 5. Utilize vertical space: Use stackable containers or baskets and label them.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] 6. Store heavy items below: Place heavier items on lower shelves or in baskets.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] 7. Keep frequently used items front and center: Store them in easy-to-reach locations.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] 8. Label and sign: Label each cabinet, shelf, or basket with its contents.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] 9. Consider a lazy Susan: Install one in a corner cabinet or on a shelf.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] 10. Maintain the space: Set aside time each week to tidy up the bathroom cabinets.
